def transform(g, verbose=False):
    bg=g[0][0]
    bs=[]; W=len(g[0]); c=0

    outs=[]

        blk=[[bg, 0 if pat[r] else bg] + ([0] if w3 else []) for r in range(len(g))]
        outs.append(blk)
    return [[c for b in outs for c in b[r]] for r in range(len(g))]
